name: Business Model Canvas
description: Strategic management template for developing and documenting business models. 9-block framework covering key areas: Customer Segments, Value Propositions, Channels, Customer Relationships, Revenue Streams, Key Resources, Key Activities, Key Partnerships, and Cost Structure.

contextTemplates.name: Customer Segments
contextTemplates.description: Who are the different groups of people or organizations your enterprise aims to reach and serve?

contextTemplates.name: Value Propositions
contextTemplates.description: What value do we deliver to the customer? Which customer problems are we helping to solve? What bundles of products and services are we offering?

contextTemplates.name: Channels
contextTemplates.description: Through which channels do our customer segments want to be reached? How are we reaching them now?

contextTemplates.name: Customer Relationships
contextTemplates.description: What type of relationship does each customer segment expect us to establish and maintain? How costly are they?

contextTemplates.name: Revenue Streams
contextTemplates.description: For what value are customers really willing to pay? What do they currently pay? How are they currently paying?

contextTemplates.name: Key Resources
contextTemplates.description: What key resources do our value propositions require? Our distribution channels? Customer relationships? Revenue streams?

contextTemplates.name: Key Activities
contextTemplates.description: What key activities do our value propositions require? Our distribution channels? Customer relationships? Revenue streams?

contextTemplates.name: Key Partnerships
contextTemplates.description: Who are our key partners? Who are our key suppliers? Which key resources are we acquiring from partners?

contextTemplates.name: Cost Structure
contextTemplates.description: What are the most important costs inherent in our business model? Which key resources are most expensive? Which key activities are most expensive?

sampleNodes.name: Tech Startups
sampleNodes.content:
# Tech Startups

Seed to Series A stage technology companies building SaaS products.

## Characteristics
- 5-50 employees
- Venture-backed or bootstrapped
- Need structured strategic planning
- Limited time for manual knowledge management

## Pain Points
- Information scattered across tools (Notion, Google Docs, Slack)
- Difficulty maintaining strategic alignment
- No single source of truth for business model

## Willingness to Pay
High - strategic clarity is mission-critical

sampleNodes.content:
# Unified Knowledge Graph

Single source of truth for all strategic and operational knowledge, automatically synchronized across local Obsidian and cloud space.

## Benefits
- **Centralized**: All business knowledge in one place
- **Bidirectional Sync**: Work locally or in cloud, always in sync
- **Visual Thinking**: Canvas support for strategic frameworks
- **Git Integration**: Full version history and collaboration

## Differentiation
Unlike Notion (cloud-only) or Obsidian (local-only), Mujarrad bridges both worlds.
